## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link related work.

## Acceptance criteria and evidence

| Criterion | Proof / input / command | Result | Evidence or gap |
|---|---|---|---|

Use PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, UNVALIDATED or NOT APPLICABLE (with a reason).
Include tested head SHA; syntax-check results and affected behavioral checks.
Distinguish synthetic fixtures, preflight, installed bundle and running process evidence.

## Review and remaining risk

State review method, findings and disposition, changed criteria or test
expectations, and any unvalidated affected surface. State when review is pending.
Include the review round and reviewed SHA, reviewer count or disclosed fallback,
findings/dispositions by round, final-confirmation result (or why not needed),
applicable unchecked dimensions, and any stop requiring a human decision.
For runtime changes, identify app/CLI target, source version, clone/profile and
unvalidated launch, login, update or Browser Use behavior. Never include secrets.
